source_context: Braydon requested a personal state system under /Users/braydon/projects/personal/personal state.
The personal instance must include entire-life context, workboard tasks, agentmem, msgvault, and the developing relationship-substrate system.
SampleCo, ResearchCo, PortfolioCo, and Plum should be treated as separate state instances, with connector/federation patterns instead of duplicated corpora.
msgvault already owns an email archive and pgvector-backed retrieval; personal personal state should query or reference it rather than create a competing raw email store.
Braydon framed himself as another abstraction, so the personal instance should use a generic entity/state-instance contract rather than a company-shaped bridge.
problem: Make the personal personal state root operational as a federated State System instance that can prove source readiness and freshness, expose gaps, build bounded context packages, and support model-owned synthesis without duplicating raw source stores.
non_goals: Do not copy raw email, agent memory, relationship, or work-instance corpora into /personal/personal state.
Do not encode deterministic whole-life scoring or company-specific ontology as the personal abstraction.
Do not add a new vector store as the default answer to every source; prefer source-owned indexes with explicit read contracts.
Do not start Speedrift autonomous execution without an explicit request.
constraints: Use /Users/braydon/projects/personal/personal state as the personal runtime root.
Use Workgraph/Speedrift as the task and dependency source of truth.
Use git worktrees for implementation waves after the plan is accepted or selected.

Respect source ownership: msgvault owns email retrieval, agentmem owns agent memory, relationship-substrate owns personal network relationship substrate, PAIA Workboard owns tasks, and work state instances own their local corpora.
Model synthesis should operate over bounded context packages with evidence and freshness metadata, and should produce proposals rather than silently accepted state.
All schema/runtime changes must preserve existing SampleCo/company behavior and pass validation plus the test suite.
success_criteria: A refresh of /personal/personal state can mechanically report readiness and freshness for declared personal sources.
The read surface exposes ready, stale, planned, and gap statuses with evidence references.
Personal personal state can federate to work instances through state_system_instance connectors rather than corpus duplication.
A bounded context package exists for model synthesis and includes provenance, freshness, unresolved gaps, and connector boundaries.
A model proposal loop can answer personal attention/state questions while preserving proposal/evidence separation.
Runbook documents refresh, inspection, vector-store implications, and source ownership.
